translations.EN: I'm working on that now.
Retrieving the item now.
On my way to pick that up.
Currently fetching the supplies.
Moving toward the item.
Grabbing it now. Won't take long.
translations.TL: Kukunin na ngayon. Mabilis lang ito.

translations.EN: Fetching as ordered.
I'm searching for and grabbing that item.
translations.TL: Hinahanap at kinukuha ko ang bagay na 'yan.

translations.EN: In transit to fetch the goods.
translations.TL: Kasalukuyang naglalakad para kunin ang gamit.

translations.EN: Retrieval in progress.
I'll fetch that.
Understood. I will retrieve the item.
I'll go grab that for you.
translations.TL: Pupuntahan ko para kunin 'yan para sa 'yo.

translations.EN: On it. Fetching the supplies.
translations.TL: Inaasikaso na. Kukunin ang mga kagamitan.

translations.EN: Right away. Going to pick it up.
Understood. I'll bring it back.
I'll secure that item.
Heading out to fetch it.
Got the order. Fetching.
Sounds good. Retrieving it now.
Here you go.
Retrieved the item. Here it is.
translations.TL: Nakuha na ang gamit. Heto na.

translations.EN: Got what you asked for.
Fetched and delivered.
Here are the goods.
Task completed. Item secured.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang gawain. Nakuha ang gamit.

translations.EN: All fetched. Safe in hand.
translations.TL: Nakuha na lahat. Hawak ko na nang ligtas.

translations.EN: Here it is. One piece.
Delivery made. What's next?
Retrieved as requested.
I couldn't fetch that.
Failed to retrieve the item.
The item wasn't there or was destroyed.
translations.TL: Wala roon ang gamit o kaya'y nasira na.

translations.EN: Way was blocked. Couldn't reach it.
translations.TL: May harang sa daan. Di ko naabot.

translations.EN: Hostiles prevented me from grabbing it.
translations.TL: Pumigil ang mga kalaban sa pagkuha ko.

translations.EN: Unable to fetch that from that container.
Lost access to the item. Fetch failed.
translations.TL: Nawalan ng daan sa gamit. Bigo ang pagkuha.

translations.EN: I couldn't find what you were pointing to.
translations.TL: Di ko nahanap ang itinuturo mo.

translations.EN: Inventory full or path obstructed. Failed.
translations.TL: Puno ang bag o may harang sa daan. Bigo.

translations.EN: Couldn't get to the target item.
I can't fetch that right now.
That's in a death trap. I'm not fetching it.
translations.TL: Nasa bitag ng kamatayan 'yan. Di ko kukunin.

translations.EN: Too far or too dangerous. Refusing to fetch.
translations.TL: Masyadong malayo o mapanganib. Tumatangging kunin.

translations.EN: My hands and pack are completely full.
translations.TL: Puno na ang kamay at bag ko.

translations.EN: I won't risk my neck for that junk.
translations.TL: Di ko isusugal ang buhay ko para sa basurang 'yan.

translations.EN: Can't retrieve that under current conditions.
I don't have the carrying capacity right now.
translations.TL: Wala na akong espasyong paglalagyan ngayon.

translations.EN: Fetch order rejected. Pick it up yourself.
translations.TL: Tinatanggihan ang pagkuha. Pulutin mo nang kusa.

translations.EN: Unable to comply. Item is out of bounds.
translations.TL: Di makasusunod. Di abot ang bagay na 'yan.

translations.EN: I can't fetch that for you.
